registry_role: Retrospective manuscript traceability index; experiments/source_lock.json is the contemporaneous commitment.

claims.statement: For f(z)=z^2+c over a complete non-Archimedean field of characteristic zero and residue characteristic two with 0<|c|<1, every exact n>=2 cycle consists of units and has multiplier norm |2|^n.
boundaries: standard local lemma; no priority claim

claims.statement: For the frozen cubic and every cycle-field place w above two, w(Lambda_C)=n*w(2) for every exact n>=2 cycle.
If the frozen exact period-n multiplier is rational, then it equals 2^n times an odd integer.
boundaries: the multiplier itself must be rational

claims.statement: Local exact cycles are unique Hensel lifts of exact Frobenius orbits, dynamics equals Frobenius on the lift, and B_C is the unramified norm.
boundaries: least dynamical period is separated from formal period

claims.statement: B_C=+/-1 forces e_{n-1}=e_{n-2}=0; this excludes exact periods two and three, while an exact degree-four Frobenius orbit passes this necessary filter.
boundaries: passing the degree-four filter does not certify equality

claims.statement: A rational repeated-return equality at ordinary Archimedean modulus 2^(nr) already forces the primitive normalized product B_C to equal +1 or -1.
boundaries: a repeated return is not relabeled as exact period nr
modulus-only without rationality is outside the argument

claims.statement: The cycle polynomial satisfies P_C(g(X))=(-1)^n P_C(X)P_C(-X), and equality B_C=+/-1 forces the displayed values at 0, +/-u, and a.
boundaries: a single-cycle polynomial need not lie in K[X]

claims.statement: The sole registered exact-symbolic audit found no B_n=+1 or B_n=-1 root in the set-theoretic exact-period records for n=2,...,7, with twelve pairs of separately implemented but algebraically equivalent exact gcd/resultant certificates and passed controls.
boundaries: finite absence is not an all-period theorem

claims.statement: A uniform exclusion B_C!=+/-1 for every n>=4 is not proved.
boundaries: individual development-seen periods four through seven are separately absent in the finite ledger

claims.statement: The 2-adic valuation result does not decide nonrational complex-modulus equality or characteristic-exponent equality.
